5.  The disc must always be thrown or launched into the air.  If you launch it on a “fly”, it can only be considered “within” the course if it is between 18 and 40 feet into the air.

6.  A throw is made by dropping the disc from a height of 18 to 40 feet, inclusive.  All throws must be made from a flat ground surface without any obstacles in front of you.  If your disc hits the ground, it is considered a drop.  However, a drop can result in a score of zero.  The score is reset for a new throw when a drop occurs.

7.  The player who makes the initial throw is the “starter”.  The player who successfully drops the disc in the hole is the “strikethrough”.
